headline: Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V Experiences Ransomware Attack
body: Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V, a key supplier in the automotive manufacturing sector, has confirmed a ransomware attack on its systems. The company has engaged incident response teams and involved relevant authorities to manage the situation. Kwangjin SLP Mexico S.A. de C.V is known for its role in supplying critical components to major automotive manufacturers.
